sequential_dependency.intermediate: Four-connected background regions in the assembled mosaic, their border connectivity and true occupied-cell areas, including channels through adjacent tiles.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Infer the background, crop the monochrome macro mask and multicolor tile, and assemble the complete tile-substitution mosaic.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Select the unique largest enclosed mosaic pocket and fill it with the original mask color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The two mask holes each contain two cells, but tile openings join different numbers of neighboring channels. After substitution they contain 62 versus 74 background cells. Choosing from mask areas alone substitutes the wrong region and changes the final output.
